summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned Step 1 (glassmorphism) of /onboarding on Expo web preview. All 9 requested checks PASSED: step 0 intro loads and 'onboarding-intro-continue' navigates to step 1; step 1 renders back button, title, both mode cards, chip-all, category-grid with all 13 categories (scienza, spazio, tecnologia, natura, animali, storia, psicologia, corpo-umano, cultura, curiosita, economia, arte, geografia), pager dots, and CTA; CTA disabled with 0 selection (aria-disabled=true) and enabled after 1 selection; category toggle logic (chip-all vs specific chips) confirmed via count-label transitions and successful navigation; mode toggles behave correctly (stories default on; both on adds lessons; can't leave both off - tapping only-active keeps it active); count labels transition 'stories' -> 'items' -> 'lessons' as expected (verified: '23 stories' -> '38 items' -> '15 lessons' on Science tile in en locale); back navigates to step 0 and returning to step 1 works; onboarding-continue with 2 selected categories POST /api/user/interests 200 + POST /api/user/content-modes 200 and app navigates to /(tabs)/discover; Explore tab renders the same CategoryGrid, toggling chip-tecnologia updates interests-count to '1 active interest' and POST /api/user/interests returns 200; light theme (localStorage pause.theme.mode='"light"') shows dark text (rgb(0,0,0) / rgb(11,14,23) / rgb(58,64,82)) on light glass surfaces - no white-on-white readability issue. No console errors; only ignorable web-only deprecation warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents, Reanimated easing on web).
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, not a bug): React Native Web does not propagate accessibilityState.checked to aria-checked on Pressable; automated assertion via aria-checked returns null. Behavior was still verified via the count-label transitions and API calls. If explicit aria-checked support is desired for assistive tech and testing tooling, consider adding an aria-checked prop or a role='checkbox' wrapper on web.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding step 1 glass redesign is functionally verified. All testIDs present. Warnings on web (textShadow*, pointerEvents, Reanimated easing on web) are ignorable per instructions.
